hero.headline: Decks, patios and roof framing in Perth, built properly the first time.
hero.subhead: Decking, patios, gazebos, screens and roof framing for homeowners across Perth, Mandurah and the Hills. Send the job through and get a clear written quote.

skyeGreeting: G'day, I'm the Perth Carpentry and Roofing assistant. Thinking about a deck, patio or roof framing job? Tell me about it and I'll help you get a quote or book a time.

about.headline: You enjoy your backyard. We handle the carpentry work properly.
about.body: Most homeowners want a clear price, a crew that turns up when it says, and an outdoor space they can use for years. Every deck, patio and frame is planned around that, from the first measure to the last screw.

cards.title: Families who live outdoors
cards.body: A deck or patio that's the right size for the table, the barbecue and the kids.

cards.title: Homes that need shade
cards.body: Gazebos, patios and screens that make the backyard usable through a Perth summer.

cards.title: Extensions and new builds
cards.body: Roof framing set out to the plans, ready for the roofer and the next trade.

about.closing: Not sure what you need yet? Tell us about the space and we'll talk it through.

problems.headline: Finding a reliable carpenter in Perth shouldn't be this hard.

points.title: Unreturned calls & slow quotes
points.body: You ring around, leave messages and still don't have a price weeks later.

points.title: Vague pricing & surprise costs
points.body: A rough figure on the phone that grows once the timber's delivered.

points.title: Missed timelines
points.body: Start dates slip and the backyard stays a building site for longer than planned.

points.title: Messy job sites
points.body: Offcuts, screws and packaging left on the lawn when the crew packs up.

problems.bridge: You shouldn't have to chase a tradie just to get a clear quote.

solutions.headline: Straightforward carpentry and roofing, built around clear communication.

services.title: Decking
services.body: New timber decks and board replacement, built level and fixed to last in the Perth sun.

services.title: Patios, gazebos and screens
services.body: Patios, gazebos, huts and screens to shade and close in your outdoor space.

services.title: Roof framing
services.body: Roof framing for extensions, patios and new builds, set out to the plans.

process.headline: We listen to what you need. Quote it clearly. Build it right.

steps.title: Request your quote
steps.body: Send a few details with the form or give us a ring. A suburb and a rough size is plenty.

steps.title: Site visit & clear scope
steps.body: We measure up, talk through options and put the scope and price in writing.

steps.title: Clean, on-time work
steps.body: A start date you can plan around, with the site tidied at the end of each day.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.body: We walk the finished job with you and sort anything on the list before we call it done.

why.headline: We're not here to rush the job. We're here to do it properly.

themes.title: Carpentry-focused
themes.body: Decks, patios, gazebos and roof framing are the whole job.

themes.title: Clear written quotes
themes.body: Scope and price in writing before any work starts.

themes.title: Clean & respectful
themes.body: Offcuts and packaging taken away, the yard left tidy.

themes.title: Direct communication
themes.body: You talk to the people building it, start to finish.

finalCta.headline: Ready to plan your deck, patio or frame?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a clear written quote before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward conversation about your project.

faq.a: Send the job through the form or give us a ring. We'll ask a few questions, come out to measure up if it's needed, then send a written quote with the scope and price.

faq.q: Which areas around Perth do you cover?
faq.a: Perth metro, Mandurah, the Perth Hills and the Avon Valley. Close by but not sure? Ask anyway.
Ask when you request a quote and we'll send through the licence and insurance details for your job.

faq.q: How soon can you look at my job?
faq.a: You get a confirmation as soon as you send a request, and we get back to you to book a time. Prefer to book yourself? Grab a slot in the calendar.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to talk through the job and arrange a measure-up if it needs one.
